therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: VEGFR1-3, FGFR1-3, PDGFR alpha and beta
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: tyrosine kinase inhibition of multiple receptor families
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: angiogenesis, tumor growth factor signaling, and stromal signaling inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic breast cancer (HER2 positive, ER positive, triple negative)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression Free Survival (PFS) according to RECIST v1.1

results.target_engagement_evidence: PK data showed drug exposure with Cmax 265-292 ng/mL and measurable AUC values
subgroup_findings: 10mg dose showed better PFS than 15mg dose (93 vs 77 days)
10mg dose showed higher ORR than 15mg dose (4.7% vs 1.5%)
safety_signals: Gastrointestinal toxicity (diarrhea, abdominal pain, duodenal ulcer)
results.dose_information: 10 mg or 15 mg once daily orally, capsule formulation
